{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The international economy has structured uneven patterns of ecological theft from land bases in the South to the North for production of high-value goods.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The North has unfairly taken up more than its fair share of the “atmospheric commons” with its greenhouse gas pollution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States owes a massive ecological and climate debt to Southern countries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Social movements in Southern countries have long called for climate reparations to ameliorate the ecological and climate debt.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Degrowth locates the imperative to pay the ecological and climate debt back in the form of grants and technological transfers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Global justice requires a transition from an unjust imperial mode of living to a just, post-carbon, ecologically coherent and solidary mode that facilitates human flourishing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Global ecological justice in the degrowth ecosocialist sense means the total elimination of world poverty and electrification of all households everywhere.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Establishing material standards for well-being is necessary for global ecological justice.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"All people have a right to a basic minimum of material goods and electricity so that they can lead the healthiest, most fulfilled life possible despite a destabilizing biosphere.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A basic minimum of material goods and electricity are the material requirements for human flourishing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
